target: Interactive inference learning workspace and Week 1 lessons

contract.purpose: Teach one bounded inference concept at a time and let the learner preserve predictions, results, explanations, and recall.
contract.canonicalPurpose: PostTrainLLM turns learning into inspectable local artifacts and bounded specialist objectives into evidence-gated Mac-local factory runs.
contract.audience: Sarthak and Mac-local practitioners learning LLM inference from first principles.
contract.job: Open the exact lesson, study and predict, do the bounded exercise, record evidence, and continue without losing prior work.
contract.thesis: Keep the established dark research-bench reading layout and bring the exercise into the same workspace.
contract.system: Existing deep-ink surface, teal active states, mono labels, large display headings, narrow lesson measure, quiet dividers, and responsive one-column reading.
contract.signature: A prediction and evidence loop beside the numbered 13-week route, with saved browser-local checkpoints.
contract.risk: A long reading page can bury the first exercise; shorter hero spacing and numbered steps bring Day 1 into view earlier.

projectCheck.command: pnpm --dir browser test && pnpm --dir browser build && node browser/scripts/check-learning-journey.mjs

findings: The lesson remains a long-form reading surface; Week 2–13 daily lessons are explicitly planned.

ownerFeedback.note: Preserve lane uses the existing DESIGN.md system; no new visual direction was selected.
